up: List all distinct compounds that are associated with document CHEMBL3639055 (i.e., compounds with a record in compound_records linked to that document via doc_id) and that have a SMILES string available (i.e., compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL). For each compound, show its ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and its canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Deduplicate by compound ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3639055' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL;
